783-2645-3430-7014.easyPrerequisites: North Pole Patrol doesn't have summoning sickness.
783-2645-3430-7014.description:
Activate Jungle Basin by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Jungle Basin
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4247-7084-7705.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Mole Man triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

141-313-3899.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Corpse Dance.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Corpse Dance
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

586-864-3125-4247-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-4247-7396.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius, History Chaser.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1603-1619-4284.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1603-1619-4284.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Evil Twin and Clone each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Evil Twin trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Clone trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1603-1619-4284.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

390-670-1619-4089.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
390-670-1619-4089.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Hulking Metamorph and Glasspool Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Hulking Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
390-670-1619-4089.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1619-2921-4605-5542-6153.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2921-4605-5542-6153.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Vicious Battlerager from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Vicious Battlerager enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Vicious Battlerager.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Vicious Battlerager that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Vicious Battlerager token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Vicious Battlerager token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Vicious Battlerager that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Vicious Battlerager trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2921-4605-5542-6153.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

944-1718-4477-7182.description:
Cast Greenwarden of Murasa for its evoke cost by paying {2} due to Planar Gate.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Catalyst Elemental from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa with haste.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Catalyst Elemental by paying {R} due to Planar Gate.
Activate Catalyst Elemental by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Catalyst Elemental dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Catalyst Elemental with haste.
Activate the Catalyst Elemental token by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
944-1718-4477-7182.notes: If you have at least {2}{R} in your mana pool on a particular iteration, step 10 can be skipped.

2511-4605-6132-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Metamorphosis Fanatic and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1010-5226-6972.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Arcbound Prototype.
When Arcbound Prototype dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Prototype's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Prototype from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

2440-6965-7108-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Sokka's second ability and each Ally you control's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve all prowess triggers, giving each Ally you control +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-6965-7108-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Ally.

250-779-1315-1479-2374.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1315-1479-2374.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Maja and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

57-1251-4846-5904.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
57-1251-4846-5904.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1069-2906-7070.notablePrerequisites:
Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
You control three or more artifacts including an Equipment.
1069-2906-7070.description:
Activate an Equipment's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The equip ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0}
Repeat.

4222-5251-6006.description:
Activate Emmara by tapping it, adding {U}.
Emmara triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Emmara.
Repeat.

4215-5147-5630-6872.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Moss-Pit Skeleton.
When Moss-Pit Skeleton dies, Long Feng and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Long Feng trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Moss-Pit Skeleton triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Moss-Pit Skeleton and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

856-5226-5477-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

4872-6308.manaNeeded: {6} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
4872-6308.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Conqueror's Foothold's fourth ability by paying {6} and tapping it, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

305-2608-4499.notablePrerequisites: Llanowar Tribe does not have summoning sickness.
305-2608-4499.description:
Activate Llanowar Tribe by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Llanowar Tribe.
Repeat.

requires.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it
with a takeover counter on it

5231-5326--5--6.notablePrerequisites:
The Master on the battlefield as a copy of either the persist or undying creature.
The Master does not have a +1/+1 counter on it if it is a copy of the undying creature, or a -1/-1 counter on it otherwise.
5231-5326--5--6.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing The Master, adding {R}.
When The Master dies, if it was a copy of the undying creature, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of the persist creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Otherwise, if The Master was a copy of the persist creature, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of the undying creature with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2751-5657-5664.description:
Cast Writhing Chrysalis by paying {2}{R}{G}.
Ulalek and Writhing Chrysalis' first ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Writhing Chrysalis spell, Ulalek's trigger and Writhing Chrysalis' trigger.
Resolve the copy of the Writhing Chrysalis spell.
Resolve the copy of Writhing Chrysalis' trigger, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate both Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens by sacrificing it, adding {C}{C}.
Each Writhing Chrysalis you control triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on each of them.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger from step 4, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Writhing Chrysalis spell, Ulalek's trigger and Writhing Chrysalis' trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

215-729-1432-2404.notablePrerequisites:
Ioreth of the Healing House does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five other creatures.
215-729-1432-2404.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least eight {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Great Oak Guardian to your hand.
Cast Great Oak Guardian by paying {5}{G}.
When Great Oak Guardian enters, it triggers itself, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House's first ability by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more creatures, this combo will net infinite green mana, which you then may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Ioreth of the Healing House any number of times.

2523-4365-4711.notablePrerequisites:
Mondrak does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least three opponents.
2523-4365-4711.description:
Declare Mondrak as an attacker.
Mondrak's myriad ability triggers, creating two token copies of Mondrak that are tapped and attacking each opponent.
Put all Mondrak tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Mondrak tokens die, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a number of nonlegendary token copies of Mondrak equal to 2^(the number of Mondraks you control) that are 2/2 Zombies.
Repeat step 5 for each remaining trigger.

826-3670-4508.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
826-3670-4508.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, giving Ingenious Artillerist all creature types until end of turn.
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ingenious Artillerist triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Ingenious Artillerist is a Pirate due to Amoeboid Changeling, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Ingenious Artillerist triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Ingenious Artillerist trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

579-2816-4137.notablePrerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to Weaver of Blossoms.Weaver of Blossoms does not have summoning sickness.
579-2816-4137.description:
Activate Blossom-Clad Werewolf by tapping it, adding {4}.
Activate Blossom-Clad Werewolf by paying {3} and untapping itself, getting +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

628-3826-4050.description:
Sacrifice Medicine Runner to make a mana of any color.
Return it with the undying trigger.
Using it's ability remove the +1/+1 counter from Medicine Runner.
Repeat.
